score.title: Civic trust score
score.noRecord: No recorded work yet, so no score.
score.howBody: Score = {d}% × fixes that held beyond 30 days + {s}% × jobs finished on time + {b}% × bills matching the standard rate. Durability and on-time are compared with what is expected for the same mix of urgent jobs, repair methods, low-lying wards and heavy-rain weeks, so a contractor given harder work is not marked down for it. Based on {n} recorded repairs{app}. Only the contractor's own recorded work is used; no one's opinion is.
score.howApp: plus {n} task(s) handled through this app
score.replyNote: Contractors can reply to any finding; the reply is shown next to it.
